app.title: Hop and Haul — fly cheap, haul the rest
meta.description: Flies you into the airport that's actually cheap, then tells you honestly whether the train ride from there is worth it.
map.aria: Trip map — click a destination to plan a route
sub: Search a place or click the map to set your destination. I compare flying direct against hopping into a cheaper hub and hauling the rest by train, bus, or car — and only recommend the split when it actually saves you money.
theme.title: Theme
theme.desc.oled: OLED black, easy on a dark cabin
theme.desc.vintage: Parchment and ink, old travel-poster style
theme.desc.contrast: Black, white, and yellow — max contrast
theme.desc.amber: Black and amber, old CRT departure board

search.placeholder: Search a city, address or landmark…
search.unavailable: Search unavailable — click the map instead
form.round: Round trip (real fares with a return date, else ≈ 2×)
badge.liveNote: — add a date for live fares
legend.sr: Map legend: blue marker is your origin airport, ink-colored marker is the destination airport, dim markers are candidate gateway hubs — the recommended hub turns green, matching the recommendation card. A dotted line is a flight leg; a dashed line is a ground leg (train, bus, or drive).
announce.readyDirect: Recommendation ready: fly direct is your best option.
announce.readySplit: Recommendation ready: {name} saves money vs flying direct.
announce.copyFail: Couldn't copy the link automatically — copy it from the address bar instead.
announce.noNearest: Couldn't resolve the nearest airport to that click.
error.network: Network error reaching the local server.
rec.directBest: The cheapest direct flight is already your best option.
rec.cleanWin: A clean win either way you weigh it.
rec.adds: Adds {hours} vs direct. Worth it unless your time is worth more than {money}/hr.
rec.atRateAhead: At {money}/hr you come out ahead by {diff}.
rec.atRateBehind: At {money}/hr you come out behind by {diff}.
rec.noSlower: And it's no slower than flying direct.
greenest.note: {name} is the lowest-carbon option here ({co2} est., vs {co2rec} for the pick above) — your call whether that's worth the trade-off.
itin.example: Example schedule, not a real booking — times are illustrative. Verify before you buy.
itin.live: Built from a real live fare — the schedule and price are real, not an example.
caution.split: Split legs booked separately aren't protected — a delayed flight can forfeit a non-refundable train/bus ticket.
caution.prices: Prices move fast — re-verify before booking.
caution.pricesEst: Prices are estimates and move fast — re-verify before booking.
err.title: Couldn't plan that route
err.fallback: Unknown error — try a different point or check your connection.
empty.title: Pick where you're headed
empty.body: Search a city above or click anywhere on the map — I'll compare flying direct against hopping into a cheaper hub and hauling the rest by train, bus, or car.
loading.title: Crunching the numbers…
lang.title: Language
dates.head: Cheapest day to fly (±{window} days)
dates.failed: Couldn't check nearby dates. The plan above still stands.
dates.cheapestNote: {date} is the cheapest day in this window at {money}, {savings} less than the date you picked.
dates.cheapestPlain: {date} is the cheapest day in this window at {money}.
dates.sameDay: The date you picked is already the cheapest in this window.
dates.notComparable: Some days were priced live and some by estimate, so they aren't directly comparable. Treat the cheapest day as a hint, not a fact.
notes.estimatePastDate: Fares are distance-based estimates. That departure date has already passed, so no booking-window or season adjustment was applied. Pick a future date. Verify before booking.
notes.estimateDateApplied: Fares are distance-based estimates. Adjusted for your booking window and the season. Verify before booking.
notes.estimateNeutralWindow: Fares are distance-based estimates. This date sits in a neutral booking window, so it did not move the fare. Verify before booking.
notes.estimateAddDateForLive: Fares are distance-based estimates. Add a date for live fares. Verify before booking.
notes.estimateNoProvider: Fares are distance-based estimates. No live fare provider is configured, so every flight fare here is modelled. Verify before booking.
notes.mixedLiveEstimate: Some legs are real live fares and the rest are distance-based estimates. Each leg's itinerary says which it is. Verify before booking.
notes.liveLookupFailed: Some live flight lookups failed and fell back to estimates.
notes.fxStatic: Some fares used a static exchange-rate table, not live rates, to convert to US dollars. Verify at booking.
notes.fxLive: Some fares were converted to US dollars using today's live exchange rate.
notes.fxUnknown: A fare priced in {currency} had no US dollar rate and is shown as-is.
notes.groupTotals: Costs are group totals for {travelers} travelers. Per-person fares are multiplied by {travelers}. Drive and rental legs are priced for {vehicles} vehicle(s).
notes.roundtripReal: Round-trip priced as real return itineraries, back on {return_date}. Times shown are for the outbound leg.
notes.roundtripEstimatedSeparate: Round-trip: outbound and return, on {return_date}, are estimated separately. Times shown are for the outbound leg.
notes.roundtripEstimated2x: Round-trip: fares shown are about twice the one-way price. Add a return date for real round-trip pricing. Times shown are for the outbound leg.
notes.ferryRealCorridor: Ferry legs are real corridors, based on bundled research: operators, typical fares, and sailings per day as of the data's date. Schedules vary by day and season, so check the operator before relying on a connection.
notes.transitLiveSchedule: Ground legs marked live schedule use real timetables from Transitous, based on community GTFS and OpenStreetMap data: real operators, departures, and door-to-door times. Fares on those legs are still estimates.
notes.lastMileGap: The nearest airport, {iata}, is about {km} kilometers from the clicked point, so the last mile to your exact spot isn't included.
notes.co2eEstimate: The carbon estimate for each option is a rough figure based on flight and ground distance, not a certified footprint. The lowest-carbon option is flagged as greenest, but it is never automatically recommended over the cheapest one.
notes.originSuspended: {iata} has no bookable service right now because of closed or restricted airspace or ground crossings. Pick a different origin.
notes.airportSuspended: No served airport is near this point. Airspace or service there is currently suspended.
